outputs.explanation: Panel A is a sequence conservation logo, not a plot of averaged data.
Bar/dot plot of inhibition zone (%) shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots overlaid for each biological replicate, as stated in the caption.
Panel C consists of epifluorescence micrographs, not a plot of averaged data.
Fluorescence intensity plot displays mean ± SEM with individual yellow dots representing individual cells, as described in the caption.
Fluorescence intensity plot (log scale) displays mean ± SEM with individual blue dots representing individual cells, as described in the caption.
Panel F shows super-resolution PALM microscopy images of representative cells, not a summary plot of averaged data.
Plot of number of clusters per cell shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots representing individual cells.
Plot of cluster sizes shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots representing individual clusters.
Plot of proportion of molecules in clusters shows mean ± SEM with individual gray dots representing individual cells.
